# SC08 experiment contract

The committed SC08 plan is authoritative for this experiment. These are synthetic laboratory contacts and resource grants, not natural incident statistics, production ingress authentication, or unseen held-out tests.

- Native audits of two materially distinct source families must make the finite VoicePolicy undertaking available. One family, equivalent replay, self-authored claims and malformed receipts cannot replace that evidence. Reordering qualified evidence preserves availability.
- The source/opportunity consumers must matter causally: removing either loses the corresponding request, and restoration recovers it. A request is a derived native effect intention, never a host-selected repair prompt.
- The continuously running driver receives later evidence, persists purpose and pending identity before model dispatch, constructs from the actual candidate, and remains available without duplicate generation or invented progress.
- Pending, paused, stopped, source revalidation, uncertain transport, incomplete transport and awaiting-independent-trial are distinct native meanings. No one of these is accepted development.
- Exactly one new local-model call is used by this package. Fake HTTP and copied model data are explicitly distinguished from that actual call. Replays validate final recovery mechanics and forbidden writers/effects without additional model attribution.
- A scoped pause/stop during a pending laboratory worker must be persisted within 500 ms at the 10 ms configured cadence. Source/grant changes prevent stale uptake. A lost possibly-sent result is not silently reissued.
- At least 10,000 native turns retain steady stack use and only material history transitions. Canonical history, checksums, authority-chain manifests, protected AtomSpaces and actual source/candidate lineage are inspected separately.

Builder JavaScript prepares fixtures, changes synthetic inputs and checks evidence offline. Runtime cognition is MeTTa; runtime transport, exact serialization/hash checks and pacing are Prolog. The finite single-undertaking driver does not establish a production multi-RNA scheduler.
